# go-modern-min-max

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use built-in min and max instead of handwritten comparisons.

## Details

The min and max built-ins express ordered comparisons directly.
They remove branch boilerplate when the logic is simply choosing the smaller or larger value.

## Examples

### Before

```go
if b > a {
  a = b
}
```

### After

```go
a = max(a, b)
```

Source: [https://github.com/JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines/blob/main/internal/guidelines/guidelines.json](https://github.com/JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines/blob/main/internal/guidelines/guidelines.json)
